pli-tv-bu-vb-pc77:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc77:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū sattarasavaggiyānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sañcicca kukkuccaṃ upadahanti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc77:1.10: ime āvuso chabbaggiyā bhikkhū amhākaṃ sañcicca kukkuccaṃ upadahantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc77:1.11: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc77:1.12: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū bhikkhūnaṃ sañcicca kukkuccaṃ upadahissantīti …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc77:1.13: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave bhikkhūnaṃ sañcicca kukkuccaṃ upadahathāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc77:1.16: hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā bhikkhūnaṃ sañcicca kukkuccaṃ upadahissatha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc77:1.17: netaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya pasannānaṃ vā bhiyyobhāvāya …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc77:1.18: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc77:1.19.1: yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhussa sañcicca kukkuccaṃ upadaheyya itissa muhuttampi aphāsu bhavissatīti etadeva paccayaṃ karitvā anaññaṃ pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc77:2.1.10: ūnavīsativasso maññe tvaṃ upasampanno vikāle maññe tayā bhuttaṃ majjaṃ maññe tayā pītaṃ mātugāmena saddhiṃ raho maññe tayā nisinnanti kukkuccaṃ upadahati āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc77:2.1.12: na añño koci paccayo hoti kukkuccaṃ upadahituṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc77:2.2.1: upasampanne upasampannasaññī sañcicca kukkuccaṃ upadahati āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc77:2.2.2: upasampanne vematiko sañcicca kukkuccaṃ upadahati āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc77:2.2.3: upasampanne anupasampannasaññī sañcicca kukkuccaṃ upadahati āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc77:2.2.4: anupasampannassa sañcicca kukkuccaṃ upadahati āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc77:2.3.2: na kukkuccaṃ upadahitukāmo ūnavīsativasso maññe tvaṃ upasampanno vikāle maññe tayā bhuttaṃ majjaṃ maññe tayā pītaṃ mātugāmena saddhiṃ raho maññe tayā nisinnaṃ iṅgha jānāhi mā te pacchā kukkuccaṃ ahosīti bhaṇati
